[Fix]

🖼️ **Up-to-date image in parcel Flows**: Fixed parcel Flow cards (for example a **WhatsApp** message after a status change) sending an image that still showed the **previous parcel status**. Every parcel trigger now gets its **own image**, drawn at the moment of the trigger with the current **status, delivery window and progress**.

[Improvement]

📦 **Image per parcel**: When several parcels change in the same sync, each Flow now receives the image of **its own parcel** instead of one shared image.

🧠 **Light on memory**: Trigger images are only drawn when a Flow actually fires, and only the **8 most recent** are kept in memory.

🌟 Enjoy the improved PostNL v1.2.11 App with notifications that always show the right parcel status.
